Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: Airlines have been forced to cancel another day of flights to Denpasar as volcanic ash continues to make its way over Bali's airspace. By 1pm, Jetstar had announced all of Thursday's flights to the holiday island had been stopped, assuring it would resume them as soon as the Volcanic Ash Advisory Centre deemed it safe to do so. Virgin has meanwhile cancelled all flights bound for Bali from Australia for both Thursday and Friday. The carrier said it would make a decision about resuming the flights headed to Australia from Denpasar midday Friday. 'Unfavourable winds have pushed the ash cloud close to Denpasar Airport over the last day and we're not satisfied it is safe to operate services in these conditions,' a statement from Jetstar said.
@highlight
Jetstar has called off all of Thursday's flights to the holiday island
@highlight
Virgin has  cancelled all flights bound for Bali  for both Thursday and Friday
@highlight
They will resume flights when Volcanic Ash Advisory Centre deems it safe
@highlight
It comes as winds bring ash from the Mount Raung volcano over Denpasar
Query: Jestar customers have been urged to check the status of their flight on Jetstar.com before travelling to airports while @placeholder is directing passengers to change their booking to another flight, which can be made at no extra charge in the next 14 days unless they prefer a full travel credit.

Options : A. Mount Raung
B. Denpasar
C. Australia
D. Bali
E. Virgin
F. Jetstar
G. Volcanic Ash Advisory Centre
H. Denpasar Airport

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
